name: Example: Controlled sources
description: Each block reads its input side and drives its output side into 10 Ω. The VCVS doubles 1 V to 2 V. The VCCS turns 1 V into 0.1 A, 1 V across the load. The current-controlled pair read the 1 A that flows through 1 Ω and the short between their input pins: the CCVS makes 10 V, the CCCS 3 A, which is 30 V on the load. The gyrator turns 1 V on its input into 1 A on its output. A source whose output current flows out of p2 shows a negative voltage on the load.
